# Stax

> Stax is a mobile-first app for buying real tokenized stocks, guided by Vera, an AI broker. It runs on BNB Chain by default: stocks from bStock and Ondo, paid in USDT, plus Bitcoin, Ethereum and BNB. Stax is the broker that knows the market is closed: Vera plans only from stocks you can buy right now and won't buy at a weekend premium.

Stax is built for people who are new to investing and to crypto. You sign in with email or Google, with no seed phrase, and Stax pays the network fees. You describe a goal in plain words; Vera turns it into a plan, you confirm with one tap, and the tokens land in your own account on-chain. Base and Mantle remain available in Settings.

## Key facts

- Invest by describing a goal in plain language to Vera, an AI broker. Nothing moves until you confirm.
- 42 stocks and funds on BNB Chain from bStock and Ondo (for example NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, SPY and QQQ), paid in USDT, plus Bitcoin, Ethereum and BNB.
- Market hours: each stock shows whether its market is open, in your own time. On weekends and US holidays Vera waits and tells you when the market opens; on weekday evenings some stocks can still be bought through Ondo.
- Price against the real share: each stock shows what its token costs compared with the real share (for example "You pay 0.20% less than the real share").
- Two issuers: most stocks come from both bStock and Ondo. Stax shows who you buy from and picks the one you can buy now that costs less compared with the real share.
- Checked with Binance: every BNB Chain trade is tested with Binance first, and a trade Binance says would fail is never sent.
- Minimum: $6 per stock on BNB Chain, the smallest trade Binance takes. With a small amount, Vera picks fewer stocks.
- Leveraged funds (such as TQQQ and SOXL) stay out of Vera's plans unless you ask for one.
- Fees: no Stax fee on BNB Chain; a flat 25 bps on what you invest on Base and Mantle. No network fees: Stax pays them.
- Email login: no seed phrase, no browser extension, no manual wallet setup. Holdings are in your own account (self-custody) and recorded on-chain.
- Eligibility: stocks are issued by bStock and Ondo on BNB Chain, Coinbase on Base and Backed on Mantle, not by Stax, for eligible people outside the United States. People in the US or other restricted regions can try the demo but cannot buy stocks.
- Accountable AI on Mantle: Vera signs each plan (EIP-712) and a contract checks her signature, your risk limit and every cent spent before money moves.
- Autopilot: rules that invest on a schedule, buy when a stock costs less than the real share, or keep a mix balanced. Rules only ever buy. On BNB Chain, Autopilot is rolling out after a funded test.
- Baskets: ready-made mixes (for example Chip Makers, Magnificent Seven, Broad Market and Stocks & Bitcoin) you can invest in with one tap, save from a Vera plan, or share as a link.
- Savings: spare USDT can earn in Venus, a BNB Chain lending app. Gifts stay on Base.
- Built for the BNB Hack: Tokenized Stocks Edition.
- Built with the Binance Web3 API (tokenized stock data, quotes and trade checks), BNB Chain, Privy (email login), Pimlico (gas sponsorship), Chainlink (reference prices), Uniswap (Base markets) and Aave (Safe Dollars on Base).
